plan.title: Skip vendor review with manual lot charges

steps.note: Attempt to open an existing event suitable for the lot-review workflow; no event title or dedicated lot-review opener is provided.

args.need: provide or open a Lot RFQ with a vendor whose Lot Adjustment is pending, ready for the Skip Vendor Review action

steps.note: The catalog cannot create or select the required pending lot-adjustment state.

args.goal: under the pending vendor's name, click Skip Vendor Review, choose Manual entry, enter the specified global charge values for every lot, enter a reason, confirm with Confirm & Skip Review, and stop on the screen showing the review was skipped and the lots show those charge values

steps.note: Use the buyer session to perform the unavailable lot-review workflow and expose whatever confirmation and charge results the screen provides.
Assert that the resulting screen has no crash, raw errors, or server failure after the attempted workflow; this does not substitute for the missing lot-charge assertion.
